recognition_primed_model.finding: Experienced fireground commanders use recognized situations to suggest a plausible action, mentally simulate it, modify shortcomings or consider another. This is a descriptive cognitive account, not a universal probability equation.
recognition_primed_model.case_locator: 2009paper p516: fireground option generation and assessment; same page USS Vincennes1988 tragedy illustrates expert failure, not an RPD success benchmark.
recognition_primed_model.boundary: Context cues, goals, expectancies, typicality and anomaly notes may be human-entered checklist fields. Exact1993/2017diagrams and detailed cases remain P1; checklist completeness cannot certify expertise.

rules: Recognition first: one recognized wins; neither recognized triggers random choice in source; both recognized proceeds to cues.
Search subjectively ranked cue validities; stop at first positive-versus-not-positive cue and choose positive. Unknown differs from negative but either can oppose positive.
Negative versus unknown does not discriminate. No discriminating cue gives random choice in source. No compensating sum of later cues.
1991version required positive versus negative; do not silently substitute that missing-data convention for1996.
worked_examples: p653 Figure1 a/b: Cue1 distinguishes; choose a.
p653 b/c: Cue1 negative/unknown skipped; Cue2 positive/negative chooses b.
take_the_best_1996.evidence_scope: Historical83German cities over100000,9binary cues; Appendix matrix. Simulation comparison is environment-specific, not universal superiority or current population data.

recognition_heuristic_2002.rule: Exactly one recognized: infer recognized object has greater criterion under positive recognition association; negative ecological association reverses direction.
recognition_heuristic_2002.example: p76 San Diego/San Antonio population illustration; historical participant recognition, not a current population query or universal guarantee.
recognition_heuristic_2002.limits: Both or neither recognized lies outside the isolated one-recognized rule. Recognition is a reported memory state, not cue negativity. No probability follows automatically from a choice; less-is-more is conditional.

expertise_conditions.finding: Predictable environmental regularities, valid learnable cues and opportunities for sustained learning with clear timely feedback constrain intuitive expertise. Confidence alone does not establish accuracy; skill is domain-specific.
expertise_conditions.proposed_gate: Record domain,experience,cue validity evidence,feedback latency/quality,changes and evaluation period. Unknown evidence stays unknown; insufficient/changed conditions warn rather than award an expertise badge.

proper_scores.finding: Strict propriety concerns unique expected-score optimization by truthful probabilities. Source maximizes reward S=-sum_j(delta_ij-p_j)^2 and log(p_actual). Proposed binary losses change sign and explicitly name scale.
proper_scores.scope: Correct scoring mathematics does not demonstrate that a person is skilled or that a cognitive model describes them.

forecast_verification.finding: Binary Brier is mean squared probability error; lower is better and base rate matters. Reliability compares conditional frequencies with forecasts; resolution concerns differing conditional event rates. Discrimination compares forecast distributions given outcomes.
forecast_verification.scope: Calibration and discrimination are distinct. An apparently small error for rare events can reflect an uninformative base-rate forecast.

sampling.finding: Sampling uncertainty depends on sample size and occurrence frequency; full inferential derivations uninspected. No universal minimum N or synthetic-fixture proof of human accuracy.

proposed_first_scope.name: Explicit Heuristic and Binary Judgment Evaluation — proposed, not a frozen executable profile
decision_input: ordered cue IDs with positive/negative/unknown per alternative
cue directions and validity/rank provenance,training interval and sample size
predeclared tie order and abstention convention
decision_output: selected alternative or abstain with reason
deterministic_conventions: Recognition-only: positive association chooses recognized, explicit negative association chooses unrecognized; unknown direction/state or both/neither recognized abstains.

1996TTB subset: preserve recognition precedence and positive-versus-negative/unknown discrimination. Both recognized searches frozen cue order. Neither recognized or exhausted cues returns abstain instead of source random guess; explicitly an editorial deterministic subset.
Equal cue ranks require a fixed pre-outcome tie order or abstain; do not claim a verified historical tie randomization rule.

Validity below0.5 or unknown orientation cannot silently be used as positive evidence. Require explicit direction recoding with provenance or reject configuration; never estimate on evaluation outcomes.
Raw validity is a conditional ecological quantity, not a universal individual forecast probability. No learned ranking or cue estimation in first core.
proposed_first_scope.selection: Freeze one latest eligible pre-cutoff forecast per forecaster/event/horizon for primary aggregate; preserve all versions and rejected/late records. Outcome occurrence must be later than forecast; reveal knowledge excluded. Same event across forecasters/horizons is dependent, not independent N.
proposed_first_scope.resolution: Predeclare occurrence endpoint and resolution evidence. Unknown/disputed/void remain visible and unscored; do not turn unresolved into0. Late changes require separate analysis, never rewrite original event definition.

numbers.binary_brier_loss: BS=mean((p-y)^2) over selected resolved pairs, y in{0,1};lower is better,range[0,1]. Exact decimal/rational arithmetic before display rounding;N=0 ->null/not_estimable.
numbers.normalization: Gneiting/Raftery quadratic reward uses negative multicategory sum. For two complementary categories, positive sum-of-squares loss=2*binary BS. This algebraic conversion is explicit; original1950body not claimed inspected.
numbers.log_loss: P1 only: -ln(p_actual),natural log,zero assigned probability to actual outcome ->positive infinity;no silent clipping. Strict JSON would need explicit infinity status/null value, not NaN/Infinity.
numbers.calibration: Freeze bins[0,.1),[.1,.2),...,[.9,1] before outcomes; report N,mean p,event count,observed frequency per bin;empty bin null,never zero-frequency. Show selected event N and unresolved/late/missing counts.
numbers.decomposition: P1: do not claim exact Brier decomposition of original unbinned probabilities after replacing them by bin means. Any exact-category decomposition or within-bin correction needs separate independent verification.
numbers.baseline: Predeclare constant base rate from disjoint earlier training sample with provenance and event definition. Evaluate on identical held-out events/horizons. Report BS and paired difference;BSS=1-BS/BS_ref only if reference loss>0,otherwise undefined. No hindsight-fit baseline advertised as predictive.
numbers.uncertainty: Descriptive first release;display N and event/group counts,rare-event and small-sample warnings. No confidence interval,p-value or independence assertion without separately verified assumptions.

proposed_first_scope.comparison: Expert/novice labels are declarations. Compare only same fixed outcomes,cutoffs/horizons and compatible domains; preserve missingness and group sizes. Measured held-out loss is evidence for that sample, not universal intuition quality.
proposed_first_scope.nonstationarity: Record cue/environment period and known changes;flag validity learned in another period or domain. No silent rolling refit or transport of historical city cue validities.
proposed_first_scope.offline: Manual inputs and local outcomes,versioned rules/hashes,replayable JSON/Markdown;existing stdlib and interfaces. No cloud,LLM,model training or new framework.
